good.narrative: The burn stops a hair short of trouble, at a point between the fifth mark and the sixth. {crew.engineer} draws it in red and {crew.pilot} says it was obviously there all along. Two units of fuel and two days buy one straight answer, and neither of them will say who lost.

poor.narrative: The real limit turns out to be very close to the first mark, and the ship finds it by passing it. Eight points of hull and six units of fuel go on the discovery. {crew.engineer} wipes the gauge in silence and draws one line. {crew.pilot} reads it and leaves it alone.

choices.sub: No marks at all. Good luck

outcome.narrative: You take a rag to all eleven. With nothing on the gauge to push against, neither of them will go near the top of the dial, and the next burn is the meekest this ship has ever flown. It saves a little fuel. {crew.pilot} keeps glancing at the blank space, and {crew.engineer} has stopped sleeping.

choices.text: Tell each of them privately they won

outcome.narrative: You take them aside, one at a time, and tell each in confidence that the other has conceded. Both are gracious about it, and then unbearable. The next burn runs hot, flown by someone who believes the argument is over. In the morning there is a twelfth line on the gauge.

science_link.text: Risk compensation: people take more risks when they feel better protected. In a Munich study, taxis with anti-lock brakes crashed about as often as taxis without them.
science_link.label: Risk compensation

title: In Honor Of

ai_flavor.aria: Two scientists, nine new species, and everyone's name in the literature! This is the most supportive workplace ARIA has ever seen!
ai_flavor.marv: Linnaeus did this to a critic, with a pungent weed, in print. The genus is still in use. The drain film can expect a similar career.
ai_flavor.rex: Nine unregistered organisms aboard, and the crew's response is to argue over what to call them. REX would start with 'hostile'.
ai_flavor.chip: Naming rights are a premium asset! CHIP could have sold that drain! Legal is now reviewing a small regional mold!
ai_flavor.ajoy: AJOY says whoever named a thing can scrub it, and two days of that would clear the drains. You'll rule on priority, because you like a rule. Do check who published first.

body:
A gray film on the growbay drain has been formally described by {crew.xenobiologist} and named after {crew.botanist}. Diagnostic features: spreads when ignored, prefers the dark, contributes nothing. {crew.botanist} has replied in the same journal, which is the ship's log, by naming a bilge slime after {crew.xenobiologist}, with remarks on its odor.

Nine species aboard now honor one or the other, and each description is worse than the last. Both want a ruling from you, in writing, on which names stand.

choices.text: Rule that the first name in print stands

outcome.narrative: Priority goes to the first name in print, and that was the drain. {crew.botanist} is now, in perpetuity, a gray film. {crew.xenobiologist} bottles the type specimen and labels it with great care, and {crew.botanist} has started taking meals alone in the growbay.

choices.text: Rule that whoever named it scrubs it

outcome.narrative: Every species aboard is assigned to its author, with a brush. In two days the drains run clear, the filters give back water that had gone missing, and eight of the nine are extinct. Each author attends a short service for the other's.

choices.text: Ask them to name one after you

outcome.narrative: There is a silence, and then the first cheerful conversation the two of them have had in days. One evening's fieldwork turns up a crust behind the aft head, and they publish jointly. They read you the proofs aloud. Tolerates neglect. Survives on very little. Widely believed to be in charge.

science_link.text: Linnaeus named a pungent weed Sigesbeckia after Johann Siegesbeck, a botanist who had attacked his system of plant classification.
science_link.label: Sigesbeckia

intro.title: THE STRIP
intro.body:
{crew.chef} has put a foil strip on your table, found in {crew.diplomat}'s jacket on wash day. Each blister held a pellet of dried miracle berry, plus something the diplomatic service declines to itemize. One on the tongue before a state banquet, and for an hour sour tastes sweet and everything else tastes polite.

Nine blisters are empty. {crew.diplomat} has praised every dinner on this ship, warmly, with adjectives.
intro.line: Every compliment. Every one of them, on a pill. I want to know what they actually think of my food.

ai.aria: Every meal rated delicious, every single time! A perfect record is a perfect record!
ai.marv: Miraculin turns acid sweet for an hour or two. The jars at the back of stores have gone to vinegar and would eat like cake. That is the good news, and MARV does not recommend telling the cook.
ai.rex: Unlabeled tablets, issued by a service nobody aboard has met, carried into the galley daily. REX would like that jacket brought to him at arm's length.
ai.chip: Taste Neutrality is a licensed benefit of the Envoy Plan! Unauthorized enjoyment of food may void it!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says the strips would rescue the soured stores, at the price of {crew.chef}'s face. You'll go for the plain dinner, since it's more interesting to watch. You won't be the one serving it.

choices.text: Sit {crew.diplomat} down to one plain dinner
choices.sub: No strip. Say what you taste
A dish built for the pellet

plain.title: NO STRIP
plain.body:
{crew.chef} serves what was served last night and stands in the hatch to watch. {crew.diplomat} takes one mouthful and stops. Then eats the rest quickly, head down, and sets the fork straight.

With the care normally kept for border disputes, {crew.diplomat} explains. The service issues the strips so that an envoy has no favorite dish. A preference is leverage. Whoever wants something can be made to pay for it.

ai.aria: A favorite dish! That's a whole new friend for {crew.diplomat}! Wanting things is the best part of having things!
ai.marv: A preference is leverage. This is correct, and {crew.chef} has just worked out what it means.
ai.rex: An envoy with a known weakness is an asset in enemy hands. The enemy appears to be holding a ladle.
ai.chip: CHIP's Preference Protection Plan covers one favorite dish per passenger! Claims are paid in soup!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says naming a price gets you gold and an envoy who resents it. Locking up the strips costs stores. She only notes that nobody has answered the question.

choices.text: Lock the strips in the galley

strips.title: TECHNICALLY CAKE
strips.body: One pellet each at the evening meal, and the jars at the back of stores, the ones that turned to vinegar, go down like dessert. {crew.diplomat} passes the strip round with practiced courtesy. {crew.chef} watches the worst food aboard get seconds, and goes to lie down.

menu.title: A COURSE FOR ONE TONGUE
menu.body: {crew.chef} takes the strip and disappears into the galley for two days with every sour thing aboard. What comes out cannot be eaten without a pellet and, with one, is logged by the ship computer as an incident. It clears the worst of the stores and has no business being that good. {crew.diplomat} finishes it, pauses and says nothing at all, which {crew.chef} takes as the first honest review of the voyage.

fed.title: A FAVORITE DISH
fed.body: You have the strips locked in the galley. {crew.chef} gets the answer, which is one word, and makes the same dinner again the next night. {crew.diplomat} now has a favorite dish, asks after it by name and is, by the standards of the service, compromised. Second helpings come straight off the stores.

leverage.title: SECONDS, AT A PRICE
leverage.body: {crew.chef} sets a price, and the service turns out to have been right. Two days later {crew.diplomat} has signed over the unspent entertainment allowance in exchange for seconds, and is asking, in a level voice, what the pudding would run to. {crew.chef} has not conceded a spoonful.

science_link.text: Miracle fruit contains miraculin, a protein that binds to the taste buds. For an hour or two afterward, sour foods taste sweet.
science_link.label: Miraculin

title: Seeing Each Other
leave_label: CAN'T LEAVE (THE NEXT BURN NEEDS AN ANSWER)

intro.title: THE SECOND SEAT
intro.body:
{crew.medic} has taken to sitting in the second seat through every burn, close beside {crew.pilot}, voices low. You drew the obvious conclusion and were quietly pleased. Tonight the circuit is left open, and what you hear is numbers. Fuel. Heading. Closure rate. Softly, one after another.

{crew.pilot} can still name a star from across the bridge and can no longer read the panel at arm's length. {crew.medic} has been reading it aloud, and has signed the fitness form.
intro.line: It's the eyes. Long flights flatten them, the near vision goes, and it may not come back. I signed anyway. Now you know what I signed.

revisit.body: The circuit is still open. Fuel. Heading. Closure rate. {crew.medic} waits for your answer between readings.
revisit.line: It's your ship. I only read it.

ai.aria: Everyone's eyes are doing their very best! The stars look wonderful from a distance, and that's exactly where they keep them!
ai.marv: The eyeball flattens at the back and focus moves outward. Stars stay sharp and dials blur. It is documented in long-duration crews, and it does not always reverse.
ai.rex: The one person at the controls cannot read them, and the medical officer signed for it. REX has seen ships lost to less. He has also seen worse second seats.
ai.chip: FlightSight™ lenses are available on a monthly plan! CHIP regrets that the plan requires the subscriber to read the terms!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says the fabricator can cut a fair lens for some wear, and you'd rather it were someone else's idea. Or fly on one pair of eyes and a voice. Ask her how much hull that plan has in it.

choices.sub: One pair of eyes, one voice

choices.text: Ask what the second seat is

seat.title: OFF THE RECORD
seat.body: You ask what the second seat is, exactly. {crew.medic} checks the door, then the panel, out of habit. {crew.pilot} has learned to fly to that voice, every number at the same pitch, and these days asks for readings that are not strictly needed.
seat.line: I've stopped being sure what to write down for that. It isn't in the formulary.

ai.aria: That is the most romantic set of fuel readings ARIA has ever heard!
ai.marv: Every reading logged, none misstated. The most reliable instrument aboard is currently a medic.
ai.rex: Second seat unassigned on the roster, and a person in it during every burn. List them before someone has to ask who was flying.
ai.chip: Unlisted copilots are not covered! One line on the roster and CHIP can start charging for the seat!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says a line on the roster costs some hull in slower calls and leaves a medbay with nobody in it. She'd take that over asking a third question.

choices.text: Enter the second seat on the roster

grounded.title: GROUNDED
grounded.body: For four days you take the stick. The burns run wider than they should and cost six units of fuel. {crew.pilot} sits in the second seat with both eyes shut, correcting each one by ear, and does not come to dinner. {crew.medic} carries a plate up to the bridge and carries it back.

lenses.title: READING GLASSES
lenses.body: Two days of hard fabricator time produce a pair of lenses: heavy, faintly ribbed and correct. {crew.pilot} holds them a long while, puts them on, reads the fuel gauge aloud without expression and then reads it again. Half-moon spectacles on a bit of cord now fly the ship. {crew.medic} still takes the second seat, and neither of them has mentioned it.

kept.title: ONE PAIR OF EYES
kept.body: You countersign the form and close the circuit. The arrangement goes on working, until one number arrives half a second late on a tight approach and the ship leaves six points of hull on something nobody read out. {crew.pilot} says nothing. {crew.medic} reads the next figure a little louder.

official.title: SECOND OFFICER (INSTRUMENTS)
official.body: You enter {crew.medic} on the flight roster, and {crew.medic} reads the entry twice. Everything now goes out loud and on the record, with a pause for the log, and the slower calls cost three points of hull on the next approach. The medbay runs on a note taped to the door. At dinner the two of them sit on the same side of the table, and you draw no conclusions.

science_link.text: One astronaut on the space station noticed, about three months after launch, that he could see Earth clearly only through his reading glasses. Long flights can flatten the eye.
science_link.label: Spaceflight associated neuro-ocular syndrome

title: Valve Three

ai_flavor.aria: Forty-one tickets and not one fault! That is the healthiest valve in the fleet, and by far the happiest!
ai_flavor.marv: Forty-one reports of a fault that has never occurred. The chance of that being about the valve is zero. The chance that either of them has noticed what it is about is also rather low.
ai_flavor.rex: REX logged the ticket series as coded traffic and spent a night on the cipher. He has cracked it. He wishes he had not.
ai_flavor.chip: Repeat service calls on a working part incur a Courtesy Fee! CHIP has billed forty-one! For a small sum, CHIP will also draft ticket forty-two!
ai_flavor.ajoy: AJOY says all that tender attention has worn the seat, and a new valve would stop the weep. She can see you looking at the wrench instead. She'll say nothing. She has said nothing.

body:
Valve 3 on the growbay line has been reported stuck forty-one times. It has never stuck. {crew.botanist} files each ticket in careful capitals, and {crew.engineer} closes each one: CHECKED. SEEMS FINE. WILL CHECK AGAIN TOMORROW.

The closing notes have been getting longer. Ticket 38 remarks on the light in the growbay at that hour. Ticket 40, filed against the valve, asks whether {crew.engineer} takes sugar. All this checking has begun to wear the seat, and the line has started to weep.

outcome.narrative: You go down to the line on third watch with a wrench and do something to Valve 3 that wear cannot explain. Some water goes into the deck. The repair takes two days, side by side under the plates, on a job that should take an hour. {crew.engineer} reports it fixed, {crew.botanist} reports it fixed, and both reports recommend checking it again tomorrow.

You sign out a new valve and {crew.engineer} fits it in twenty minutes. The weep stops and the line gives back what it was losing. A perfect repair, and there is now nothing wrong with Valve 3 that anyone could report. By morning Valve 4 has been reported stuck.

choices.text: Put them on the same watch
choices.sub: Cite a rule that doesn't exist

outcome.narrative: You rewrite the watch bill, citing a regulation you make up on the spot. They turn up at the same hour, each appalled, each carrying two mugs. With both of them on one watch the other goes unstaffed, and the ship wanders a little off its burn. Valve 3 is reported stuck twice more that night, by someone sitting next to the person who fixes it.

intro.title: SPECIMEN 12 / YOUR EXCELLENCY
intro.body:
Something the size of a plum came in on the intake filter, and it now sits in a sealed jar on the lab bench, pulsing. {crew.xenobiologist} has logged it as Specimen 12 and booked the cutting board for morning. {crew.diplomat} has logged it as Your Excellency and presents credentials to the jar twice a day, pulsing back with a flashlight.

Neither will leave the room while the other is in it, so you have been sent for.
intro.line: Mark it and show it a mirror. If it touches the mark, it knows it's someone, and I put the blade down. That's fair. I said that's fair.

ai.aria: A new friend in a jar, and two wonderful people arguing over how to welcome it! ARIA has drafted a banner in both languages!
ai.marv: Apes, elephants, magpies and a small reef fish have passed this test. An animal that fails it may still know perfectly well who it is. Neither party wishes to hear that.
ai.rex: Unknown organism, sealed in a jar, receiving visitors twice a day. REX reminds the captain that this is how occupations start.
ai.chip: CHIP can offer the jar a Residency Package or a Specimen Plan! CHIP will bill whichever of them survives!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says cutting pays at once, and the test costs an hour and a dab of dye. You'll want to pick a side, you always do. She'd look in the mirror first.

choices.sub: A dab of dye, a shaving mirror

choices.text: Grant it a shelf and a place at table

mirror.title: AN EXCHANGE OF NOTES
mirror.body:
{crew.xenobiologist} dabs it with dye and stands a shaving mirror against the jar. For an hour, nothing. Then the pulsing quickens, turns toward the glass and goes on all night.

{crew.diplomat} brings the transcript to breakfast. It has not recognized itself. It has recognized the other one, as a sovereign power. Notes were exchanged. Relations broke down before dawn over the dye mark, which each side blames on the other.
mirror.line: That's a fail. I'd like it noted that it's a fail with a foreign policy.

ai.aria: It's made a friend! And then an enemy! So much personal growth in one jar!
ai.marv: It has failed the test and opened hostilities with a shaving mirror over a dye spot. Its note of protest is consistent, and better argued than most.
ai.rex: War has broken out on the lab bench. REX respects a force that picks a fight the moment it sees its equal.
ai.chip: War-risk coverage for reflective surfaces starts at a very reasonable rate! CHIP has already sold it to the mirror!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says lifting the mirror away ends it fastest and lets the jar think it won. Shuttle talks take two days. She wiped the glass earlier, which she's told was an act of aggression.

choices.sub: Let the jar win the war
One side of it is glass

choices.text: Take a sample while it's distracted

cut.title: SPECIMEN 12
cut.body: {crew.xenobiologist} opens the jar in the morning and works with great care. The samples will pay for themselves, and the notes are excellent. Organ seven, they conclude, is very probably a seal of office. {crew.diplomat} reads that line, closes the file and begins drafting an apology, with no idea whom to address.

lodged.title: YOUR EXCELLENCY
lodged.body: {crew.xenobiologist} signs the transfer in very small letters. The jar gets the good shelf, a clean cloth and a place at table, with rations drawn in its name. It has made no requests. {crew.diplomat} takes this as strength.

won.title: VICTORY IN THE JAR
won.body: You lift the mirror off the bench. The pulsing stops, starts again and settles into something slow and enormously pleased. By the next watch the jar has produced a small hard bead and pushed it against the glass. {crew.diplomat} translates this as reparations, and {crew.xenobiologist} translates it as waste. Both have asked to hold it.

treaty.title: THE SHAVING MIRROR ACCORD
treaty.body: For two days {crew.diplomat} carries messages from one side of the jar to the other, a distance of nothing, with a straight face. The Accord grants each party the dye mark on alternate days. {crew.xenobiologist} signs as witness and is, against all training, moved. The jar goes back on the shelf, facing its old enemy, at peace.

spied.title: INCIDENT
spied.body: While it is busy at the glass, {crew.xenobiologist} lifts the lid and takes a small sample from the side facing away. {crew.diplomat} finds the lid a quarter turn out and says nothing. The next morning's transcript is a formal protest, addressed to the mirror.

science_link.text: In the mirror test, an animal is marked where it cannot normally see. Touching the mark in a mirror suggests it sees itself in the reflection, not another animal.
science_link.label: Mirror test

intro.title: THE EXCHANGE
intro.body:
A chalk line now crosses the deck at the galley hatch. All peelings, stalks and trimmings go over it in one bucket, at one agreed hour, with {crew.chef} on the galley side and {crew.botanist} on the growbay side, neither speaking, like two powers swapping spies on a bridge.

{crew.chef} wants the bucket for stock. {crew.botanist} wants it for compost. Today's has stood on the line since breakfast, and you have been asked to rule.
intro.line: Stock feeds people. Ask {crew.botanist} what compost feeds. Then ask when they last ate any of it.

ai.aria: A border! Every ship should have one, so that it has something to open!
ai.marv: A working heap holds fifty-four degrees or better on bacteria alone. The pot needs ship's power. Neither party will accept this as a ruling.
ai.rex: Demarcation line on deck, scheduled handovers, two hostile parties and one bucket. REX has stood on that bridge. Search the bucket.
ai.chip: Cross-border peel transfers are subject to a handling fee! BucketPass™ clears customs in under a minute!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says boiling it first gives each side half and you the blame. She'd take the chef at their word and ask the other question. You won't, but that chalk is getting on everything.

choices.sub: Soup now, less for the bed

choices.text: Award it to the compost bed
Boil it first, then hand it over
Ask when {crew.botanist} last ate any of it

table.title: THE ONLY ROAD IN
table.body:
{crew.botanist} goes quiet, then says it to the deck. Never. Nothing from that growbay, not once. It is hard to eat something you have sat up with. A fresh plate goes back with the good part moved to one side, and you had not thought much of it.

{crew.botanist} goes back over the line. {crew.chef} waits for the hatch to close. The stock was never about the peelings.
table.line: It's in the broth. It has been in the broth all along. I wasn't going to say.

ai.aria: Surprise vegetables are the very best kind of friendship!
ai.marv: A share of every bowl has come out of the growbay. The assay takes minutes. {crew.botanist} has the instrument, and has never once pointed it at dinner.
ai.rex: A covert feeding operation against a member of this crew, with no casualties. REX has rarely been so moved, and will deny it.
ai.chip: Farm-to-Table dining is a Platinum benefit! The farm is eleven meters from the table, and a delivery fee applies!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says the broth is kind and will go on working. A real plate means one hard dinner in front of everybody, which is three people. She knows which you'd skip.

choices.text: Rule for the pot and say nothing

stock.title: FOR THE POT
stock.body: You rule for the pot. {crew.chef} carries the bucket over the line like a returning hero, and the ship eats well. The bed goes short, and by the next watch you can see it in the {crop.name}. {crew.botanist} stays on the far side of the chalk and does not look up.

compost.title: FOR THE BED
compost.body: You rule for the bed. {crew.botanist} forks the bucket in, and within a day it is warm to the touch from nothing but its own bacteria, and you can see the good of it in the {crop.name}. {crew.chef} makes stock from the memory of a bone. Dinner is clear, hot and accusing.

both.title: NEGOTIATED SIMMER
both.body: Two days of supervised boiling. {crew.chef} gets the flavor, {crew.botanist} gets the remains, and each is sure the other got the better of it. The arrangement is fair, which neither of them forgives.

sit.title: ONE PLATE
sit.body: You pull out a chair. {crew.chef} brings a small plate of the {crop.name}, plainly done, and stands well away. {crew.botanist} sits in front of it until it has nearly gone cold, then eats all of it without a word. Then, in a flat professional voice, comes the first honest report the growbay has ever had: short of potassium, third row, you can taste it. The instruments had missed it.

broth.title: IT STAYS IN THE BROTH
broth.body: You rule for the pot, with the remains to go to the bed, and say nothing else. The chalk wears off in a day or two and stays worn off. {crew.botanist} finishes a whole bowl that night and allows that it isn't bad. {crew.chef} turns away and does something unnecessary to a pan.

science_link.text: A compost heap makes its own heat. Microbes oxidizing carbon warm it, and a well-run hot heap holds 54 to 71 °C until the material has broken down.
science_link.label: Compost

intro.title: HAND-DELIVERED
intro.body:
Mail has caught up with you, which should not be possible at this speed. A captain you have never met pulls level, apologizes for the intrusion and sends a document tube across on a tether. {npc.quirk}

Inside is a land deed in your name, opened, and resealed with great care.
intro.line: This reached me by mistake. The Land Office mailed it to the property, and the property is my address. It seems it is also yours. I opened it, for which I apologize. I am also going to beat you there.

ai.aria: A neighbor already! ARIA always says the best part of owning land is the people standing on it!
ai.marv: Their deed and this one name the same parcel. MARV has seen shorter wars start over less acreage.
ai.rex: This stranger crossed open space to return your mail, and now knows your hull, heading and speed. REX would have done exactly that. Then he would have fired.
ai.chip: Congratulations on your property! CHIP's HomeShield™ covers everything except title disputes, acts of neighbor, and arrival!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says that gold spends today and a deed spends years. You have already got that look, so she will save the rest for later, when it can do some good.

revisit.body: The two deeds stay up on the screen, side by side, agreeing with each other.
revisit.line: I can wait. Not long. I have a race on.

choices.sub: It has your name on it

compare.title: SAME SECOND
compare.body: Laid side by side, the two deeds agree on the parcel, the boundary, the price and the filing time, to the second. Each is stamped VALID. Each forbids the other. The Land Office was dissolved the next morning, and its forwarding address is the property.
compare.line: I have read mine eleven times and it does not improve. Whoever lands first and plants something will have the better argument. I intend to have the better argument.

ai.aria: Two deeds means twice the land! ARIA has run the numbers and they are very exciting numbers!
ai.marv: Two valid titles, one parcel, no office left to appeal to. Neither side can win this on paper, and MARV finds that restful.
ai.rex: "Whoever lands first." REX has heard that rule before. It generally gets shortened to "whoever lands."
ai.chip: CHIP's RaceToSettle bundle includes a flag, a shovel and one prewritten apology to the neighbors! Terms apply to the neighbors!
ai.ajoy: They crossed open space to tell you they are your enemy. AJOY has met enemies, and they do not bring the mail. She would keep an eye on that one, since you won't.

kept.title: TWO OWNERS
kept.body: You sign for it. The other captain logs the signature, wishes you a safe trip and appears to mean it, then opens the throttle as far as it will go.
kept.line: Good. I would have thought less of you. See you at the property.
kept.narrative: Took delivery of a deed to the landing site, and acquired a neighbor.

sold.title: SOLD
sold.body: You sign it over. The other captain counts the gold across twice, in case it is too much, and locks both deeds in one tube. Their ship turns and goes, in no hurry now.
sold.line: That was the easiest thing I have done all year. I am not sure I like you for it.
sold.narrative: Sold a claim to the landing site to the only other person who wanted it.

title: Lane Closed

ai_flavor.aria: Decorations! Someone went to so much trouble! ARIA counts eleven little orange friends!
ai_flavor.marv: A licensed buoy costs more than a month of fuel. Somebody has worked out that four days of your time are worth eleven of them. MARV checked. They are correct.
ai_flavor.rex: Eleven markers, even spacing, no warheads. REX has laid this exact pattern, with warheads. He is keeping clear of the fourth one on principle.
ai_flavor.chip: LANE CLOSED is a service mark of LanePartners! CHIP can reopen this lane as soon as your subscription clears!
ai_flavor.ajoy: AJOY draws your attention to the asterisk, which nobody asked her to do. You could always take the detour, of course. You do love a detour.

body: Eleven orange buoys have been strung across the lane, each flashing LANE CLOSED AHEAD in the color reserved for real authorities. Each message ends in one small asterisk. Their registration comes back to the other claimant, who appears to have paid the full licensing fee on all eleven.

outcome.narrative: Forty kilometers on, a twelfth buoy reads: *IT ISN'T. Beneath that, smaller: SORRY. The other claimant could not bring themselves to falsify a navigation aid. This one has been parked directly in the lane, and takes some of your paint on the way past.

The detour runs four days through a drift of comet ice that no chart mentions and no trap requires. Your tanks fill. Somebody chose this route with care: if you had to lose four days, they would rather you lost them somewhere pleasant.

Section 9 gives the holder every marker pointing at the property. You serve notice on the buoys, which do not contest it, and winch in all eleven. A copy of the notice goes to their former owner, with a receipt.

choices.text: Add a footnote of your own
choices.sub: One buoy, one can of paint

outcome.narrative: You go out with a can of hull paint and give the fourth buoy a second asterisk, with a note of your own. It concerns their landing technique and runs to two lines. The ride back in is the best part of the week.

science_link.text: In the Land Rush of 1889, some settlers slipped in before the legal start and hid. They were called Sooners, and they left hundreds of legal contests over who got there when.
science_link.label: Land Rush of 1889

intro.title: A BETTER REASON
intro.body:
Their hail comes in on the distress channel, which is new. Engines cold, lights off to save power. {npc.quirk}

The Claims Registry has finally ruled, and they read it out in full. Where two deeds conflict the site goes to neither holder, unless one surrenders a deed before landing or fails to arrive.
intro.line: I have four hundred people asleep in the hold, and they sold everything they had for this parcel. How many have you got? I am asking you for your deed. I have never asked anyone for anything, so I may be doing it badly.

ai.aria: Four hundred new friends! ARIA is sure there is a version of this where everyone gets a parcel!
ai.marv: Four hundred sleepers checks out against their mass on approach. MARV was hoping it wouldn't. Lying would have been so much less work for you.
ai.rex: Cold engines, dark ship, unprompted confession. REX has run this ambush. He notes, with some discomfort, that it may not be one.
ai.chip: CHIP can broker this transfer for a modest percentage of the planet!
ai.ajoy: AJOY has seen a printer on this ship and she has seen a galley, and she is not suggesting anything. Four hundred people is a lot to lie to. She would simply like it noted that you can.

revisit.body: Their lights are still off. The channel stays open, and carries nothing.
revisit.line: I am still here. I have not got the fuel to be anywhere else.

buoys.title: NOT SENT
buoys.body: A long pause on the channel, then a document: an itemized invoice for eleven navigation buoys, with the total circled. Across the top someone has stamped NOT SENT.
buoys.line: I am not sending it. I only want you to know that it exists.

ai.aria: An invoice they won't even send! ARIA calls that a friendship!
ai.marv: The total is accurate. MARV would not have circled it twice.
ai.rex: A debt held in reserve is ammunition. REX has logged it as such.
ai.chip: CHIP can factor that invoice for you at a very competitive rate per buoy!
ai.ajoy: AJOY did mention the buoys belonged to someone. She mentioned it after you took them, but she did mention it.

footnote.title: CORRECTIONS
footnote.body: They send back a scan of the fourth buoy. Your spelling has been corrected in red, and there is a small tick beside the second line.
footnote.line: The second line was fair. I read it out to my officers. It changes nothing.

ai.aria: They read your work! ARIA is so proud of you, published author!
ai.marv: The corrections are right. MARV had been waiting for someone else to raise them.
ai.rex: Psychological warfare, returned with annotations. REX respects it and wants it stopped.
ai.chip: CHIP offers proofreading from just nine gold per insult!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would have used a semicolon. That is all she will say about it, for now.

gave.title: ONE DEED
gave.body: The tube goes back across on a tether. They read the deed through twice, in case you have made a mistake, and then their running lights come on one at a time.
gave.line: I do not know what to say, which has not happened before. I will think of something, and I will put it in writing.
gave.narrative: Gave the other claimant your deed, because they asked.

refused.title: NOTED
refused.body: They take it well, by which you understand that they write it down. One at a time their lights come back on, and the ship turns away, slowly, with four hundred people in it.
refused.line: Then I will find another way. You should know that I am good at that.
refused.narrative: Told the other claimant no, with four hundred people listening.

forged_chef.title: RICE PAPER
forged_chef.body: {crew.chef} presses the sheet from rice flour, stamps it with a carved potato and seals it in caramel. Across a tether it is a deed. They read it through twice, and their running lights come on one at a time. Then they thank you, which is the hard part.
forged_chef.line: I do not know what to say. I will think of something.
forged_chef.narrative: Sent the other claimant a forged deed, made in the galley, and kept the real one.

forged_print.title: FINE PRINT
forged_print.body: The fabricator takes a morning over the seal. Somewhere in the fine print it adds the word SAMPLE, because it is that kind of machine. Across a tether it is a deed. They read it through twice, their running lights come on one at a time, and then they thank you, which is the hard part.
forged_print.line: I do not know what to say. I will think of something.
forged_print.narrative: Sent the other claimant a printed forgery and kept the real deed.

cut.title: CHANNEL CLOSED
cut.body: You cut them off mid-sentence and fly on. Their ship stays dark in your wake until it is too small to see. Nobody on your side of the channel brings it up.
cut.narrative: Hung up on the other claimant while they were asking.

hail.title: RE: THE PROPERTY
hail.body: Your name comes up on the channel in full, followed by the word RE:. The other claimant has stopped across the lane, which the message header calls the access road. {npc.quirk}
hail.line: I have prepared for several versions of this conversation. Let us find out which one we are having.

ai.aria: An old friend! ARIA loves that they dressed up the message!
ai.marv: Their ship sits across the lane to within a meter of its center. MARV suspects this has been rehearsed.
ai.rex: Ship across the lane, formal header, rehearsed opening. REX is familiar with this ceremony. It is the last one before the other one.
ai.chip: This conversation is being recorded for quality and litigation purposes!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would take the call. If it goes badly, going around them costs more than listening did, though she accepts you have never let that stop you.

choices.sub: They have been to the Registry

blocked.title: FAILS TO ARRIVE
blocked.body: They read the clause aloud: if one holder fails to arrive, the other takes the site unopposed. They add nothing to it. Their gun covers are off, and you can see from here that the covers have been folded.
blocked.line: I have four hundred people and one idea left. Turn back at the next stop and I will pay your fuel. If you will not, I will stop you. I would like it on the record that I asked.

ai.aria: They folded the covers! Such care! ARIA knows a good heart when she sees a good hospital corner!
ai.marv: Their hull is thinner than yours and their gunnery is better. MARV gives you the fight at slightly better than even, and the conversation at somewhat better than that.
ai.rex: Finally. REX has been saying "whoever lands" since the first leg. He would like the record to reflect that as well.
ai.chip: CHIP reminds you that SiteGuard™ Mutual pays out on either party's destruction, at a discount, to the survivor!
ai.ajoy: If you still have the deed, AJOY has read further into it than you have, and Section 14 is short. If you don't, you might mention that. She would not start with the guns, which means you will.

revisit.body: Their gun covers stay folded. Somewhere behind them, a great many people are still asleep.
revisit.line: Well?

choices.text: "I told you to find another way."

another.title: ANOTHER WAY
another.body: A short pause. Faintly, behind them, someone can be heard telling the gun crews to wait.
another.line: You did. I found one. This is it.

ai.aria: They listened to you! ARIA calls that a real connection!
ai.marv: MARV did warn that the sentence could be taken literally.
ai.rex: A clean reply. REX would have said less, from closer.
ai.chip: CHIP's ConflictPlus™ tier includes unlimited last words!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would have let them have that one too.

forged.title: NOT A DEED
forged.body: Held up to their screen is what the Registry returned of your deed, stamped NOT A DEED, with a fine attached. It has been handled a great deal. Behind it, their gun covers are off.
forged.line: The clerk laughed. I want you to understand that. I have been a serious person my whole life, I stood at that counter for four hundred people, and a clerk laughed.

ai.aria: A clerk laughed! ARIA thinks making people laugh is the greatest gift of all!
ai.marv: The fine is correctly calculated. The clerk's laughter is, MARV understands, not itemized. He advises against saying so.
ai.rex: They have stopped writing things down. REX considers that the most dangerous thing they have done yet.
ai.chip: CHIP's ForgeryShield™ would have prevented this! CHIP's ForgeryShield™ is also how CHIP gets the fine waived, for a fee!
ai.ajoy: AJOY did not suggest this. She pointed out that there was a printer, in a general way. Paying the fine is the cheap version of being sorry, and she expects you'll want the cheap version.

choices.sub: They will take it in fuel

lease.title: CLAUSE FOUR
lease.body: They have drafted a lease. It fills one page, the rent is modest, and there is a clause about noise. The Registry, they explain, will let nobody down on the site but the holder and the holder's tenants. They sound tired, and they have spelled your name correctly.
lease.line: I have never been anyone's landlord and I do not care for it. Sign this and I will never mention it again. I will mention it once a year. That is clause four.

ai.aria: A lease! ARIA has always wanted to have a landlord and a friend in the same person!
ai.marv: The rent works out to less than the fuel for this conversation. MARV has read a lot of leases. This one was written by someone trying to be kind and getting it wrong.
ai.rex: REX reads clause four as a standing right to approach. He would like it struck.
ai.chip: CHIP notes that rent is just ownership with a better subscription model!
ai.ajoy: You gave away the only thing that got you down on that site for free, and AJOY has not said a word. She would like that appreciated. Do read clause seven.

fight_line.title: FOR THE RECORD
fight_line.body: The channel stays open as the guns come round.
fight_line.line: All right. For the record, I asked.

held.title: SECTION 14
held.body: Section 14: no holder shall obstruct another on the access road to the property. You read it slowly. A captain who reads clauses aloud cannot fire through a subsection, and both of you know it. The gun covers go back on and are straightened.
held.line: I filed a complaint about Section 14. I have never been so sorry to be overruled.
held.narrative: Read the other claimant a subsection, and they moved their ship.

helped.title: FOUR DAYS IN THE TRAYS
helped.body: {crew.botanist} spends four days in the other ship's growbay, which is failing in a way anyone could have spotted if they had slept. The guns stay out the whole time. When the trays turn green, the ship moves aside without a word.
helped.line: My people will eat. I have added that to the file, on your side of it.
helped.narrative: Saved the other claimant's growbay at gunpoint.

argued.title: ADJOURNED
argued.body: You sit with the engines cold and argue it across the lane, filing by filing, for four days. In the end they accept that shooting you settles nothing they cannot settle at the property. They move. The bill for the air you both used arrives separately.
argued.line: This is not over. It is adjourned.
argued.narrative: Spent four days arguing across a blocked lane, and won the right to keep flying.

run.title: THROUGH THE GAP
run.body: You go around them at full burn with every light off. One shot clips the hull on the way past, and a formal note of protest arrives before the shaking stops.
run.narrative: Ran the other claimant's line at full burn, and took a shot and a note of protest.

squared.title: PAID IN FULL
squared.body: You pay it. They count it, enter it, and leave the channel open a moment longer than they need to. The ship swings out of the lane. Nothing has been forgiven, but it has been receipted.
squared.line: The clerk still laughed. You cannot pay that. Go on.
squared.narrative: Paid the fine on a forgery you sent, and were let through.

real_deed.title: THE REAL ONE
real_deed.body: The real deed goes across on the same tether. They spend a long time on it, then enter it, then put the old one somewhere you cannot see. Their gun covers stay off until you are well clear.
real_deed.line: You had this the entire time. I wish you had not told me that.
real_deed.narrative: Sent the other claimant the real deed, late.

brazen.title: GARNISHED
brazen.body: They do not answer. A boarding line comes across, a fuel hose follows it, and the fine is collected from your tank by someone who keeps very careful count. The hose goes back. Their ship does not say goodbye.
brazen.narrative: Told the other claimant the forgery had worked, and paid for that in fuel.

signed.title: TENANT OF RECORD
signed.body: You sign. They countersign, file it and mark the first anniversary in their calendar with visible reluctance. Their ship clears the lane, leaving you a copy and a small printed card that lists the quiet hours.
signed.line: Welcome to the property. I hate this.
signed.narrative: Signed a lease on the site you used to own.

dinners.title: PAYMENT IN KIND
dinners.body: {crew.chef} sends a covered dish across as a first installment. Two days and a good deal of correspondence later, clause three reads ONE DINNER, WEEKLY, and the words "rent is not a compliment" have been added in the margin.
dinners.line: Rent is not a compliment. Tell them the sauce was correct.
dinners.narrative: Agreed to pay your rent in dinners.

unsigned.title: NO FIXED ADDRESS
unsigned.body: They look at the blank signature line for a while, then file the lease under PENDING. The ship clears the lane. You now hold no title, no tenancy and a strong position on principle.
unsigned.line: The offer stands. It stands very awkwardly.
unsigned.narrative: Declined to rent what you gave away.

science_link.text: Pheasant Island, in a river between France and Spain, is a condominium. Its administration alternates between the two nations every six months.
science_link.label: Pheasant Island

alongside.title: BEFORE ANYONE LANDS
alongside.body:
Whatever the other claimant is flying by now, it has come alongside, and its captain would like one more conversation before anybody lands. {npc.quirk}

The surveyor's report is in at last. Someone has walked the parcel end to end. It is still the same size, which both of you had hoped to be wrong about.
alongside.line: We are nearly out of trip. I would like to settle this while we can both still claim to be reasonable.

ai.aria: Together again at the end! ARIA has been saying this was a love story since the first leg!
ai.marv: The parcel measures what both deeds said. It is the only thing about this matter that has been correct.
ai.rex: Same captain, closer range, no shots yet. REX is not calling that a good sign. He is calling it a sign.
ai.chip: CHIP congratulates all parties on reaching the Final Settlement Phase™ of their journey!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would hear them out. She has been telling you that since they brought your mail, and it has been a long time to be right about something.

proposal.title: SIX MONTHS EACH
proposal.body: Their proposal fills one page. For six months the parcel is theirs, for six months it is yours, and each side keeps the grounds tidy for the other. Two countries have run an island in a river on those terms for over a hundred years. They have checked, and attached the island.
proposal.line: Keep your paper or lose it, I find I no longer mind. Six months each. I am told the handover gets to be a kind of holiday.

ai.aria: Half a year of neighbors and half a year of peace! ARIA thinks that is the most romantic thing ever filed!
ai.marv: Two ships, one site, twelve months. MARV has checked the division twice. It is the first clean result anyone has had from this parcel.
ai.rex: REX has held a position in six-month rotations. Nobody enjoyed it. Nobody was shot, though, and he supposes that is the sort of thing civilians count.
ai.chip: CHIP's TimeShare™ Colonial plan would have cost you twice this! CHIP is upset about that!
ai.ajoy: AJOY says take it, which you will now not do, because she said it. If you insist on standing on the deed, stand on it knowing that the four hundred pay rent to you for good.

revisit.body: The page is still on the screen, with a space for your name.
revisit.line: Whenever you are finished being difficult.

choices.sub: They owe you a better split

shots.title: PRIOR USE
shots.body: A small sound on the channel, which your translator declines to classify.
shots.line: There was. I have entered it under prior use of the access road.

ai.aria: Water under the bridge! Hull under the bridge! ARIA forgives everyone!
ai.marv: Your damage and theirs come to about the same repair bill. MARV offers that as the nearest thing here to justice.
ai.rex: REX has shared a table with people he shot at. Better food than you would expect.
ai.chip: CHIP can bundle your combat history into a convenient NeighborScore™!
ai.ajoy: AJOY thinks that went better than you deserved. Sign something.

forgery.title: FRAMED
forgery.body: They hold something up to the screen. It has a frame now, and a small brass label.
forgery.line: I kept it. It is the only funny thing anyone has ever done to me, and I would like you to know I have not forgiven it.

ai.aria: It's on the wall! ARIA says that makes you a collected artist!
ai.marv: The label has the date right, and the wording of the fine. MARV finds the frame more alarming than the guns.
ai.rex: Trophy of a past engagement, displayed openly. REX knows exactly what that means, and it is not friendship. It might be friendship.
ai.chip: CHIP notes that framing services are available at participating stations!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would stop talking now. She knows you won't, but she would.

corner.title: THE CORNER WITH THE SPRING
corner.body: They send over a plan of the parcel with one corner penciled off. It is the corner with the spring, which their surveyor marked as the best ground on the site. Nothing obliges them to do this, and they are annoyed about it.
corner.line: You gave me something you did not have to. I have been trying for weeks to be insufferable about it, and I cannot get it right.

ai.aria: A corner of your very own! ARIA always knew generosity was a sound investment!
ai.marv: The spring is real and its flow is respectable. MARV has run out of reasons to object and resents it.
ai.rex: A corner with water and one approach road. REX could hold that. He wants that noted as a compliment.
ai.chip: Your Complimentary Corner™ may be subject to neighborly goodwill!
ai.ajoy: AJOY told you, at the time, that you would regret giving it away, and here you are, regretting it with a spring. Take the corner. You can be proud some other year.

choices.text: Take the corner under your lease

choices.sub: You gave. That was the gift

shared.title: ALTERNATING SOVEREIGNTY
shared.body: You put your name on the page. A case of their stores comes across on the tether as a first courtesy, and a duty roster for the handover follows it. Their people will wake to half a landing site, and so will you, and neither of you has to burn anything down to get it.
shared.line: I am going to be a very difficult neighbor. Six months a year.
shared.narrative: Agreed to share the landing site, six months on and six months off.

shared_best.title: FIRST CHOICE OF SEASONS
shared_best.body: You mention four days in a growbay. They turn up the file, read your side of it and write in, unasked, that you get first choice of seasons and a share of every tray {crew.botanist} saved. The courtesy case that crosses the tether takes two people to shift.
shared_best.line: I said I had added it to the file. I am a person of my word, which has been expensive.
shared_best.narrative: Agreed to share the landing site, on the better half of the calendar.

won.title: SOLE HOLDER
won.body: You file first, on the last day the Registry is sitting, and you file well. With four hundred people to land they cannot wait out an appeal. They sign their deed over and rent the east field from you at a price you set. The first payment arrives on time. All of them will.
won.line: Congratulations. I mean that. I always mean it. That has been the whole problem.
won.narrative: Took the whole site, and four hundred tenants with it.

courts.title: IN THE ORDER RECEIVED
courts.body: You decline to discuss it. The matter goes before a Registry that no longer has an office, where it will be heard in the order received. They close the channel without comment, and you get the distinct impression that a file has been moved to a higher shelf.
courts.narrative: Left the landing site to the courts.

neighbor_lease.title: GROUND RENT
neighbor_lease.body: The corner goes on the lease as a schedule to clause three. They attach a drawing of the spring, a jar of its water for testing, and six crates of something that will grow in it. The first anniversary reminder arrives at the same time.
neighbor_lease.line: Clause four. See you in a year. See you tomorrow, I suppose.
neighbor_lease.narrative: Took the corner with the spring, under the lease.

neighbor.title: A GIFT, RELUCTANTLY
neighbor.body: They write your name on the corner in pencil, then, after a long look at it, in ink. A tank of the survey water comes across on the tether so you can taste what you have. It tastes of iron and something like an apology.
neighbor.line: It is a corner. Do not make this into a moment.
neighbor.narrative: Took the corner with the spring, freely offered.

walked.title: CLEAN HANDS
walked.body: You send the plan back unsigned, with thanks. There is a long silence, in which someone on the other ship can be heard being told about it. The channel closes. They have kept the pencil line on the plan, and you know this because they send you a copy every year.
walked.line: You are the most irritating person I have ever failed to beat.
walked.narrative: Gave up the landing site, and turned down the corner offered in return.

science_link.text: Donor hearts have historically been transplanted within about six hours of procurement. The time spent in transit is called cold ischemia time.
science_link.label: Organ procurement

intro.title: PERISHABLE
intro.body: There is no such thing as a passage on a colony ship, which has not stopped anyone printing a ticket. Its holder is in your airlock with one steel case, two locks, and the calm of someone who has done this before. {npc.quirk}
intro.line: Medical courier. That is a heart, for a transplant, and someone at your destination is waiting on it. Do not open the case and do not ask. You have the only cold hold going that way, and I can pay.

ai.aria: A heart! There is finally a heart aboard! ARIA has been saying this ship needed one!
ai.marv: Donor hearts have tended to go in within about six hours. MARV has looked up your arrival date, and he mentions the two figures side by side and without comment.
ai.rex: No manifest, no medical credentials, two locks. REX would put a guard on the hold. He would put the guard on the passenger first.
ai.chip: CHIP's OrganExpress™ delivers in two to four business years!
ai.ajoy: That case came through your airlock like furniture, and nobody has asked why a heart needs two locks. The fare is good. AJOY only mentions it as someone who sleeps near the hold.

revisit.body: The passenger waits in the airlock with the case, in no visible hurry for someone carrying a heart.
revisit.line: The cold hold, if you please.

choices.text: Stow the case, find them a bunk

keep.title: A VERY GOOD CASE
keep.body: They consider the question, then the case, then you. A sticker on the lid reads THIS SIDE UP. It has been applied, you notice, to the side currently facing down.
keep.line: This one keeps. It is a very good case.

ai.aria: Modern medicine is a marvel! ARIA feels sure hearts keep much longer now that we believe in them!
ai.marv: No container on record keeps a heart for the length of this trip. MARV has reported that. It is all he can do, and he has done it.
ai.rex: That was not an answer. REX has heard that exact non-answer from a man with a bomb in a cello.
ai.chip: Ask about CHIP's ExtendedFreshness™ warranty, void on opening!
ai.ajoy: AJOY notes that you asked the right question, got no answer and are about to take the money. She has seen you do this with fuel, too.

choices.text: Stow the case, find them a bunk

aboard.title: ONE PASSENGER
aboard.body: The case goes down to the cold hold and takes up one slot. The passenger takes the spare bunk, pays the fare in clean gold and asks what time dinner is. For someone in a hurry to save a life, they unpack a great many things.
aboard.line: Thank you. You will never know how much.
aboard.narrative: Took on a paying passenger with a heart in a locked case.

refused.title: AIRLOCK CYCLED
refused.body: The outer door closes on the passenger, the case and the ticket. They do not argue, which bothers you more than an argument would have. For the next few nights you find yourself wondering whose heart it was.
refused.narrative: Turned a medical courier away at the airlock.

intro.title: WITH RESPECT
intro.body:
Someone has sent the case a fruit basket.

It came clamped to the hull, addressed TO THE CASE, WITH RESPECT, and it is the third this leg. The card, in very good ink, reads LONG MAY YOU REMAIN SHUT. The passenger regards the fruit without surprise. {npc.quirk}
intro.line: Well-wishers. Hearts are very popular.

ai.aria: Fruit! For a heart! ARIA thinks that is the sweetest thing a heart has ever received!
ai.marv: Three baskets in one leg is not sentiment. It is a maintenance schedule. MARV would like to know what is being maintained.
ai.rex: A sealed package attached to the hull from outside, and everyone is treating it as a kindness. REX has scanned the pears. He would like to scan them again.
ai.chip: CHIP's GiftConcierge can return unwanted tribute for store credit!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would look under the fruit. People who pay this much for packing generally expect it to be read.

revisit.body: The basket sits on the galley counter, smelling expensive.
revisit.line: Do have a pear.

asked.title: EXPENSES
asked.body: They consider a pear, then the question, and appear to prefer the pear. Then they lower their voice, on a ship with nobody to overhear.
asked.line: Grateful people. There is generally an envelope under the fruit. I have been keeping those, as expenses, but I could split them with you. Call it hazard pay. For hearts.

ai.aria: Free money from a heart's well-wishers! ARIA says this ship's luck is really turning around!
ai.marv: Hospitals do not tip. MARV has been through the envelope's weight, and it holds about forty gold, paid monthly, by someone who expects something for it.
ai.rex: Accepting cash from an unknown party is how REX's last posting ended. It had been a very nice posting.
ai.chip: CHIP reminds you that undeclared envelopes are taxable in most jurisdictions and a fun surprise in the rest!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would like it noted that they offered this before you had asked for anything. In her experience, that is the most expensive kind of free.

eaten.title: OUT OF SEASON
eaten.body: It is excellent fruit. Nothing in the basket is in season anywhere, and two of the varieties have been discontinued. You eat it anyway, and the next basket comes in on schedule.
eaten.narrative: Ate a fruit basket addressed to a locked case.

slip.title: PACKING SLIP
slip.body: {crew.chef} unpacks it onto the counter, tests a pear and finds the packing slip under the straw. Billed to the Clearing Ring, nineteen member stations. Account: UPKEEP OF THE RESERVE. {crew.chef} keeps the slip and the pears, and the passenger watches both go.
slip.line: Clerical error, I expect. Hospitals are a nightmare.
slip.narrative: Found a packing slip in the case's fruit basket, billed to something called the Reserve.

cut.title: HAZARD PAY
cut.body: Half of it crosses the galley table in clean gold. Neither of you counts it, which is how you both know it has been counted. The passenger slides a pear across as well, and goes back to their bunk humming something with no tune.
cut.line: There now. You are practically in medicine.
cut.narrative: Took a share of the envelopes that come with the fruit.

intro.title: A FORMALITY
intro.body:
An examiner from the Clearing Ring would like a moment of your time, and has brought a warrant, a receipt book and a small bright drill. {npc.quirk}

Nineteen stations keep their accounts in Ring gold, all of it backed by one reserve in one sealed case, unaudited for three hundred years. It was last seen leaving in the company of your passenger.
intro.line: I am required to ask for it. I am required to drill both locks and count what is inside, before witnesses. A formality. I have waited my whole career.

ai.aria: Three hundred years without a single audit! ARIA thinks that shows wonderful trust!
ai.marv: The warrant is in order. The warrant is the only thing here that is. A sealed reserve no one may count has one likely reason for being sealed, and MARV has been sitting on it since the first pear.
ai.rex: Anyone who brings their own drill has rehearsed this. REX would like to know who else is watching. He would also like the drill.
ai.chip: Ring gold spends at all participating stations, until further notice!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would ask the passenger before doing anything, and would not expect the truth. She has seen them with a pear.

revisit.body: On the examiner's desk the drill turns over once, to show that it works.
revisit.line: Whenever you are ready.

choices.text: Bring the passenger to the comm
choices.sub: They have some explaining to do

aside.title: A SECOND OPINION
aside.body: The passenger arrives with the air of someone asked to identify a coat. Out of the examiner's hearing, in a voice with all the medicine gone out of it, they tell you that it is not a heart. It is the reserve. They took it so that nobody could ever put a drill in it, and you might like to consider what becomes of nineteen stations' savings if somebody does.

ai.aria: Not a heart, but still full of heart! ARIA is keeping an open mind about the rest!
ai.marv: That is the second story. MARV notes that it, too, has been told to you by someone who wants something.
ai.rex: A subject who changes cover under pressure has at least one more cover. REX would ask for the third one now.
ai.chip: CHIP's parent company has no comment on the solvency of nineteen stations and would like to know which ones!
ai.ajoy: AJOY told you there were two locks. She is not going to bring that up. She is merely thinking about it, near you.

gave.title: RECEIVED WITH THANKS
gave.body: The examiner weighs the case, stamps the receipt and counts out a finder's fee in Ring gold, every coin of it perfectly confident. Behind you in the doorway, the passenger has stopped pretending to read.
gave.line: Thank you. You have no idea how long I have wanted to see inside that.
gave.narrative: Handed the locked case to an examiner from the Clearing Ring, for a fee.

tin.title: NINE KILOS
tin.body: {crew.chef} finds a tin of about the right size, packs it with nine kilos of ration brick and fits two padlocks from the dry store. It crosses on a tether. The examiner weighs it, writes down the weight and thanks you in triplicate. Behind you, the passenger is making a sound you hope is laughter.
tin.line: Remarkable. I have goosebumps, in the sense that applies to me.
tin.narrative: Gave the examiner a sealed tin of ration brick and called it the reserve.

tin_print.title: NINE KILOS
tin_print.body: The fabricator prints a steel case with two locks, near enough, and you pack it with nine kilos of ration brick. It crosses on a tether. The examiner weighs it, writes down the weight and thanks you in triplicate. Behind you, the passenger is making a sound you hope is laughter.
tin_print.line: Remarkable. I have goosebumps, in the sense that applies to me.
tin_print.narrative: Gave the examiner a printed case of ration brick and called it the reserve.

slip.title: KEEPER OF RECORD
slip.body: An examiner may seize stolen property. Property for which the Ring has been paying monthly upkeep, to your ship, is another matter, and you read out the slip's account line slowly enough to be taken down. The examiner closes the receipt book with great care and puts the drill back in its fitted box.
slip.line: Well argued. The Ring has never been in a hurry. That is rather the point of it.
slip.narrative: Read an examiner their own packing slip until they went away.

sent.title: DECLINED, WITH RECEIPT
sent.body: You decline. The examiner records this, tears off your copy and sends it across, then sits in the lane for most of a day, in case you have changed your mind. The drill stays on the desk. You can see it from here.
sent.line: The Ring has never been in a hurry. That is rather the point of it.
sent.narrative: Sent the Clearing Ring's examiner away, with a receipt.

galley.title: THE GALLEY
galley.body: Late in the watch you find the passenger at the galley table with the lights down, no longer troubling to look like a courier. {npc.quirk}
galley.line: We should talk, before somebody else does.

ai.aria: A heart-to-heart! ARIA has been so looking forward to the heart part!
ai.marv: Their luggage has been packed for six days. MARV mentions this because nobody asked.
ai.rex: Unattended passenger, reduced lighting, your ship. REX has moved one item of cutlery out of reach.
ai.chip: This confession may contain forward-looking statements!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would sit down. You have been avoiding this since the first pear, and she has been counting.

choices.sub: The news has reached the ship

run.title: ASSETS: SEE CASE
run.body: The audit took eleven minutes. Word of the result took nine: both locks drilled, and inside, one sheet of paper reading ASSETS: SEE CASE. By the next watch Ring gold is being refused at nineteen stations, your own purse included, and every trader in range wants something real.
run.line: Thirty years I kept that shut. I have nothing to say to you. I came to watch you find out what money was.

ai.aria: Everyone is getting a fresh start on their finances! ARIA calls this a nineteen-station spring cleaning!
ai.marv: A reserve backed by itself, for three centuries. MARV does admire the construction. Your gold loses value at the rate people can read, and people are reading quickly.
ai.rex: Bank run. REX has held a door against one. Nobody thanked him, and the door did not survive.
ai.chip: CHIP is pleased to confirm that CHIP accepts all major currencies, of which there are now fewer!
ai.ajoy: Spend it, while it spends. AJOY knows you like to sit on things and see. This is the wrong thing to sit on.

choices.text: Spend it while it still spends

brick.title: THE BRICK STANDARD
brick.body: The examiner has certified the audit: nine kilos of ration brick, sealed, counted and witnessed. Every exchange on the Ring has begun quoting gold against rations. Your galley, the passenger points out, now holds a measurable fraction of the money supply.
brick.line: That is the first time there has ever been anything in there. I want you to appreciate that. Thirty years, and you fixed the currency with lunch.

ai.aria: ARIA always said this ship's food was worth its weight in gold! ARIA was early!
ai.marv: One brick now trades at more than its nutritional value, which was a low bar. MARV gives the standard about a year. Bricks keep longer than that. Confidence doesn't.
ai.rex: REX has moved the dry store onto the list of strategic assets. He wants it guarded, and he wants nobody eating a treasury.
ai.chip: CHIP is launching BrickCoin™ this afternoon! Get in early! Don't eat it!
ai.ajoy: AJOY mentions that the bricks were never good and are now legal tender, and that you have been putting legal tender in soup. Sell some, or don't. You'll only be wrong in one direction.

confession.title: MONETARY POLICY
confession.body: They put it plainly. Nineteen stations' money rests on a case nobody may open. A reserve in transit cannot be audited, so they have kept it in transit for thirty years, one hired ship after another, under one excuse after another. It was a kidney for the last ship. You have been flying a central bank.
confession.line: Ask me what is in it. No, do not. That is the whole of monetary policy.

ai.aria: You run a central bank! ARIA would like the ship's budget reviewed at once, in a good way!
ai.marv: If the case is full, a thief has done no harm. If it is empty, a thief has been holding up nineteen stations for thirty years. The second one fits the fruit. MARV takes no pleasure in it.
ai.rex: This person has used nine or more ships as cover. REX wants to know how many of them arrived.
ai.chip: CHIP offers premium secrecy at a flat percentage of whatever isn't in there!
ai.ajoy: You could open it. You could also put it out the lock, or keep flying. AJOY has noticed which one you just looked at, and she only got that airlock clean last week.

revisit.body: The passenger has not moved. There is a second cup on the table now.
revisit.line: Go on. I have all night, and most of the decade.

choices.sub: A case no one can reach
You have a ship to run

wages.title: CUSTODIAL GRADE
wages.body: They seem delighted to have been asked.
wages.line: Wages. You went on the Ring's books with that envelope: custodial grade, no pension. In law you have been hiding this thing for as long as you have been paid to, so do mind your tone.

ai.aria: A job with the Ring! ARIA always knew you would get a promotion!
ai.marv: Their reading of the law is correct. MARV looked. He had rather hoped to find something.
ai.rex: Blackmail, delivered with a smile, or the local equivalent. REX has it in his report.
ai.chip: Custodial grade qualifies you for CHIP's Accessory Rewards™ program!
ai.ajoy: AJOY mentioned the most expensive kind of free. She will wait while you remember.

spent.title: LAST GOOD PRICE
spent.body: You buy food and water from the last trader in range who will still take it, at a price that doubles while you are counting. The tanks are fuller. The purse is lighter, and what is left in it has begun to feel like a very small collection of medals.
spent.narrative: Spent your gold on food and water while the Ring fell.

held_gold.title: LONG-TERM HOLDER
held_gold.body: You hold on. The price of your gold is posted at every stop you can raise, and it goes in one direction. By the next day a share of what you had has simply stopped being anything, though it still looks very nice.
held_gold.narrative: Held your gold through the fall of the Ring, and watched a share of it stop being money.

barter.title: HARD CURRENCY
barter.body: {crew.botanist} opens the seed locker and goes on the air. For four days the ship trades packets of spare seed for tank water at panic rates, one small envelope at a time. It is the only stable market on the Ring.
barter.narrative: Traded spare seed for water at the height of the panic.

mint.title: LEGAL TENDER
mint.body: You sell rations by the crate, at face value, to people who insist on a receipt. Gold comes in. Dinner goes out. The buyers have no plans to eat any of it, which you find is the most insulting thing anyone has said about the galley.
mint.narrative: Sold ship's rations as currency during the Brick Standard.

eat.title: CONSPICUOUS CONSUMPTION
eat.body: Dinner goes on. It is the same dinner, but somebody now works out what it costs, out loud, between mouthfuls. A second helping is roughly a small moon's annual budget. Nobody declines it.

debase.title: QUANTITATIVE EASING
debase.body: {crew.chef} cuts every brick with filler and presses the result into two bricks. The ship now holds more money and worse dinners, and so far the exchanges have noticed neither. It is, by any historical standard, sound policy.
debase.narrative: Stretched the ration stores, and with them the money supply.

opened.title: ASSETS: SEE CASE
opened.body: Neither lock was ever locked. Inside, on green baize, lies one sheet of paper: the reserve's entire balance sheet, in small clean type. ASSETS: SEE CASE. You read it twice and shut the lid. Behind you, the passenger pours a second cup and pushes it across the table.
opened.line: Now there are two of us. It does not get any lighter.
opened.narrative: Opened the case and read what the reserve was made of.

sunk.title: OUT OF CIRCULATION
sunk.body: You carry it to the lock yourself and cycle it out. It tumbles away with both locks shut, exactly as valuable as it has ever been. The passenger watches from the port until it is a dot, and then for a while after that, and begins, very quietly, to laugh.
sunk.line: Do you know, in thirty years, I never once thought of that.
sunk.narrative: Put the reserve of nineteen stations out of the airlock.

demand.title: PROFESSIONAL COURTESY
demand.body: They count it out without argument, from somewhere you did not know they kept gold, and with a look of real approval that stays with you longer than you would like. It is the look of someone recognizing a colleague.
demand.line: There. Now you are not a dupe, you are a partner. People generally find the second one worse.
demand.narrative: Took a cut of the secret to keep flying with it.

quiet.title: NOTHING TO DECLARE
quiet.body: You finish your cup and go back on watch. Nothing changes, except that you now pour a little less water, count the stores a little more often and do not sleep very well. For thirty years, somebody has been doing this alone, and you begin to see how.
quiet.narrative: Heard what the case was, and said nothing.

title: In Transit

science_link.text: Ownership of a great rai stone on Yap could change without the stone moving. One sank to the sea floor and was never seen again, and it went on being traded.
science_link.label: Rai stones

leave_label: CAN'T LEAVE (THEY ARE ON YOUR SHIP)

settle.title: SETTLING UP
settle.body: With the end of the run in range, the passenger has packed, which took less time than you would have thought, and comes to the bridge to settle the account. {npc.quirk}
settle.line: There is the matter of the case.

ai.aria: Everyone gets to go home! ARIA has loved having a heart aboard, whatever it turns out to have been!
ai.marv: Thirty gold fare, three baskets a leg, one secret. MARV has the running total, should anyone wish to feel worse.
ai.rex: REX will be glad to see them off this ship. He would be gladder to see them off a higher one.
ai.chip: Please rate your passenger on a scale of one to CHIP!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would check the spoons. Then she would listen.

choices.sub: It comes down to a form

ledger.title: THREE BOXES
ledger.body: They lay it out in a sentence, in case nobody has. Nineteen stations' gold rests on one sealed reserve, and the reserve's only real asset is that it has never been counted. The Ring wants it accounted for by arrival, and has sent a form. The form has three boxes: HELD, RETURNED, LOST.
ledger.line: Mark whichever you like. They are all lies of about the same size.

ai.aria: A form with only three boxes! ARIA has never felt so free!
ai.marv: On Yap, a stone at the bottom of the sea went on changing hands, because everyone agreed it was there. MARV suspects that nineteen stations are about to be offered the same deal.
ai.rex: HELD keeps you in the line of fire. RETURNED puts it back in the hands of a professional liar. REX cannot find a box marked SECURE. He has looked on the back.
ai.chip: CHIP can file this form for you for just three percent of the reserve! Whichever reserve!
ai.ajoy: You will want HELD, because it pays. AJOY only asks you to look at what is written next to LOST, and to remember how well you sleep.

revisit.body: The form stays on the console, three boxes, one pen.
revisit.line: Any time before arrival.

choices.sub: Whatever that turns out to mean
You have read it, after all

sheet.title: A MATTER OF PRESENTATION
sheet.body: They look at the ceiling for a moment, with what may be pride.
sheet.line: I did. It was empty when they gave it to me, and I felt that looked unprofessional.

ai.aria: They added value! ARIA calls that real initiative!
ai.marv: So the reserve increased by one sheet under their tenure. MARV has seen worse central banks. Not many.
ai.rex: A forged balance sheet in an empty case. REX has stopped being surprised, which he considers a defeat.
ai.chip: CHIP would like to hire this person for Investor Relations!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would like it known she always thought the type looked homemade.

brick_check.title: MARKET REPORT
brick_check.body: They read the morning's exchange rates with visible enjoyment.
brick_check.line: Up two percent. It is the strongest currency on the Ring. People have started to nibble.

ai.aria: A strong currency you can eat! ARIA is so proud of that lunch!
ai.marv: Nibbling is a contraction of the money supply. MARV estimates a recession by the end of the quarter, with crumbs.
ai.rex: REX recommends a guard on the reserve. A second guard, to watch the first one eat.
ai.chip: BrickCoin™ is up! CHIP accepts no liability for teeth!
ai.ajoy: AJOY told you that brick would come back to you. She meant in the soup, but she'll take this.

gone.title: ANY SEALED CASE
gone.body: What is left of the Ring has been sold for scrap, and the passenger's fare went with it. Nineteen stations are trading in water and favors. A delegation has written to ask whether anyone knows of a sealed case, any sealed case, with nothing much in it.
gone.line: Give them a month. People will believe in anything with a lock on it. In the meantime I cannot pay you, and I would like a lift.

ai.aria: A whole new currency, ready to be believed in! ARIA can feel the confidence coming back already!
ai.marv: The Ring lasted three hundred years on one sheet of paper. MARV gives its successor about the same, for the same reason.
ai.rex: They broke a banking system and now want a lift. REX has them down as the most dangerous person he has ever served soup.
ai.chip: CHIP is delighted to announce the new CHIP Reserve™, backed by the full faith and credit of CHIP!
ai.ajoy: That delegation pays real money for a tin. AJOY only mentions it because you are about to be noble, and the galley has a very good tin.

choices.sub: The last basket in the hold

held.title: CUSTODIAN
held.body: You sign as custodian. The Ring's stipend clears within the hour, and the next basket is already on its way to your landing site, where others will join it, quarterly, for the rest of your life. The passenger leaves the case exactly where it is and seems ten years lighter.
held.line: Do not open it. Do not ask. You will be surprised how quickly that turns into a personality.
held.narrative: Signed for the reserve of nineteen stations, and kept it shut.

returned.title: RETURN TO SENDER
returned.body: They take the case back and tick the box themselves. A final fare arrives from somewhere. By the time you think to count the pears, they have taken those too, and the next ship's ticket has been printed in your spare bunk's name. There is a new excuse. You rather hope it is a good one.
returned.line: A lung, I think, this time. Goodbye. You were one of the more tolerable banks.
returned.narrative: Gave the case back to the passenger, who was already selling the next ticket.

lost.title: AT AN UNKNOWN DEPTH
lost.body: You tick LOST, and if the case is still aboard it goes out the lock that night. The Ring files the form, records the reserve as present at an unknown depth, and goes on trading it. Prices hold. A thing nobody can reach cannot be counted. The passenger reads the filing twice and pays you out of the last envelope.
lost.line: A stone at the bottom of the sea. Thirty years, and it took a stranger with a pen.
lost.narrative: Marked the reserve LOST, and nineteen stations went on trading it.

fruit.title: FINAL SETTLEMENT
fruit.body: They settle up with the last basket of the Ring, which has arrived anyway, the order having been placed before the news. The card still reads LONG MAY YOU REMAIN SHUT. It is good fruit, and you eat it looking at the card.
fruit.line: The pears were always the only sound asset. I did try to tell people.
fruit.narrative: Took the passenger's last fare in fruit.

new_reserve.title: THE NEW RESERVE
new_reserve.body: {crew.chef} wipes out a lunch tin, seals the lid with solder and declines all questions about the contents. The delegation pays in the only gold still moving, and bears the tin away on a small cushion. Trade resumes in nineteen stations by the end of the month. The passenger is misty about it, or whatever applies.
new_reserve.line: Beautiful work. Never tell me what you put in there. That was not sentiment, that was professional advice.
new_reserve.narrative: Sold nineteen stations a sealed lunch tin to believe in.

forgave.title: WRITTEN OFF
forgave.body: You tell them to forget the fare. They look at you for some moments, as if for the catch, and then enter it somewhere as a bad debt. It is the nearest thing to a thank-you you are going to get, and it is more than nineteen stations did.
forgave.line: Writing that down as a loss. It is the first honest entry I have made in thirty years.
forgave.narrative: Let the passenger off the fare, after everything.

title: Do Not Eat the Last Ones

intro.title: LANDLORD'S REGRET
intro.body:
LANDLORD'S REGRET, says the paper packet on your screen, in ink older than your ship. POLE BEAN. DO NOT EAT THE LAST ONES.

The seed-freighter behind it has no business this far out, and its pilot is looking your ship over as if pricing it for scrap. {npc.quirk}
intro.line: You're outbound, and outbound is the one direction the lawyers can't follow quickly. I don't like you. I don't have to. Thirty-one keepers had this before me, and none of us liked the next one either.

ai.aria: A bean with a legal team! ARIA thinks the keeper is warming to us! That was definitely a warm kind of contempt!
ai.marv: About forty seeds, and that freighter is carrying a day of fuel past what it needs. Two things are running out. MARV can see which one its pilot is worried about.
